levels.surface: أبا جعفر محمد بن علي الباقر

notes: The compiler's own name opens the text and is not written (owner ruling 1); «أبي» is his father, a bare relation
«وعن محمد بن زياد» starts its own route after Ahmad; «محمد بن جمهور» ends the text's names, so the two routes are two groups
«(1)» is a footnote marker and is left out
